Messages.Author: Coyote
Messages.Body:
I have read the ruling about this combo but my doubt refers about the text change.

Original text was "put this card on him or her"

the new text is

Name: Descent into Darkness
[Gehenna:C, POD:DTC]
Cardtype: Action
Cost: 1 blood
Discipline: Obtenebration
+1 stealth action.
[obt] Put this vampire and any cards and counters on them out of play (breaking any temporary control effects) and put this card in play. During your influence phase, this vampire can gain 2 blood, and you can choose to burn this card to return the vampire to play (in the same region as they were before), locked.
[OBT] As above, but the vampire is unlocked as they return to play.

Bold on relevant.

I see I didn't set this clear. The scenario is after a minion has been stolen by the mind rape. And the Methuselah that stole it, use it to play a Descent into darkness. What happens when the minion returns to his original controller.
.  Player A plays mind rape on minion X of player B Player B plays his turn normally. Minion X remains locked Player A burns mind rape and gets minion X unlocked Player A plays Descent into darkness with minion X Minion X returns to player B (DiD breaks temporary control)  If you put DiD in play (like army of rats) and not on the minion (like the original text) then when the minion change controls back to his original controller DID doesn't change of controller and therefor the original player choose to burn it or not.

So with the change of text also changes completely the synergy with mind rape.

Is my reasoning correct?

Actually I guess that the new text tried to avoid the problem that, as a card on a permanent out of play is also out of play, technically DiD could not be used to bring back the vampire to play as it also out of play (and it could not be used)

In that case, I would recommend adding something like this so it's online with LSJ's rulling.

"put this card in play (this vampire's controller controls this card)"

Mind rape

Name: Mind Rape
[Sabbat:R, SW:R, KoT:R]
Cardtype: Action
Cost: 2 blood
Discipline: Dominate
[dom]  Bleed with +2 bleed.
[DOM]  Lock a younger vampire and put this card on that vampire; you still control this card. This vampire does not unlock as normal. During your next minion phase, burn this card to unlock this vampire and take control of him or her until the end of your turn.
Artist: Scott M. Bakal; Brian LeBlanc

Messages.Body:

David Resende - Prince of Teresina

Messages.Author: Coyote
Messages.Body:
Descent into Darkness breaks immediately the temporal control from Mind rape. So as soon as you play DiD the vampire returns to his permanent controller. (the scenario is about when the Vampire has been temporarily stolen. Not before.)

And the controller of the vampire doesn't decide when the vampire returns.
The controller of DiD decide. That's the point. If DiD is on the vampire, the controller of the vampire is the controller of DiD. If DiD is on play, the player that played DiD is the controller.

Messages.Author: Coyote
Messages.Body:
Player A plays mind rape on minion X of player B
Player B plays his turn normally. Minion X remains locked
player A burns mind rape and get minion X unlocked
Player A plays Descent into darkness with minion X
Minion X returns to player B

Old text says that DiD is put on the minion. So when minion returns to player B, he controls DiD and can choose to burn it to return minion X to play.

New text puts DiD on play. So when Minion X returns to player B DiD is still controlled by player A and he can choose not to burn DiD forever so minion X is permanently out of play

I hope this clear it.

Yes, this is an issue. It should read (errata):

Messages.Author: Coyote
Messages.Body:
Thanks Ankha

As a judge, I have now a doubt.
If I find this issue in a tournament and the text is still not corrected in the card list, how should I proceed?

If I stick to the rules, I should rule according to the actual text from the card list (and allowing this issue).

I know this is an extremely rare case, but I am thinking in a more general view. I understand the card list from VEKN is official to rule changes, updates and erratas from cards.

So if a card is errated but still not corrected in the card list (like it is Descent now) I understand that I should still rule using the official text.

Correct?

Messages.Author: Coyote
Messages.Body:
And to make it shorter, I would delete the part of "and any other cards and counters on them". Cards and counters on a card out of play are implicitly out of play. So this line is almost redundant.

"this card remains in play" is enough to override the general rule.

It just my opinion.
